description:
Cast Lava Spike by paying {R} and choosing to pay {1}{R} and reveal Desperate Ritual from your hand, adding Desperate Ritual's effects onto Lava Spike, with Lava Spike targeting an opponent.
Cast Desperate Ritual by paying {1}{R}, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Izzet Guildmage's second ability by paying {2}{R}, copying Lava Spike, targeting an opponent.
Resolve the copy of Lava Spike, adding {R}{R}{R} and dealing three damage to an opponent.
Repeat from step 4.
